message: This endpoint accepts only quote_id, connection_id, and connection_token (all non-empty strings, no other fields).
next_action: Complete the free /v1/agent setup flow first (BEGIN_EMAIL_VERIFICATION, VERIFY_EMAIL_CODE, DISCOVER_PRODUCT, CONFIRM_PRODUCT, then PREFLIGHT_MONITORING) to obtain a matching quote_id, connection_id, and connection_token, then retry this request with those exact values.
